description: This file defines the storage interface and its implementation for etcd, handling snapshot management, WAL operations, and versioning within the storage package.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: Interface defining storage operations such as save, snapshot, close, release, sync, and version retrieval.

classes.name: storage
classes.description: Implementation of the Storage interface managing snapshotting, WAL, and versioning.

methods.name: NewStorage
methods.description: Constructs a new storage instance with provided logger, WAL, and snapshotter.

methods.name: SaveSnap
methods.description: Saves a snapshot to disk and records it in the WAL.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases resources older than a specified snapshot, including WAL locks and snapshot database files.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves hard state and entries to WAL.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the WAL and finalizes storage.

methods.name: MinimalEtcdVersion
methods.description: Determines the minimal etcd version compatible with current WAL and snapshot state.
